divergences.label: blockhash() entropy
divergences.forkBehavior: Returns 0x0 for every block mined after the fork block (Foundry issue #837)
divergences.mainnetReality: Returns correct 32-byte hash for blocks N−256 to N−1; changes every 12 seconds
divergences.failureMode: Commit-reveal salts derived from 0x0 instead of real hash; reorg detection never fires
divergences.fix: vm.roll() + historical block-range replay for commit-reveal patterns; explicitly assert blockhash() return value

divergences.label: MEV competition
divergences.forkBehavior: Zero searchers in local Anvil mempool; swaps execute at quoted price with no front-running
divergences.mainnetReality: 72,000+ sandwich attacks per 30 days on Ethereum; 0.3–0.8% of swap value extracted per attack
divergences.failureMode: Slippage tolerance calibrated in fork is too loose for production; arbitrage profit estimates are overstated
divergences.fix: Historical sandwich replay via Tenderly against known attack blocks; unit-test slippage guard at 0.3–0.8% extraction rates

divergences.label: EIP-1559 basefee
divergences.forkBehavior: Frozen at fork block value; after first tx, opcode and eth_feeHistory may disagree (Foundry issue #3762)
divergences.mainnetReality: Adjusts ±12.5% per block based on block fullness; rose +50.8% over 35 blocks on June 22, 2026
divergences.failureMode: maxFeePerGas cap set 10% above frozen fork basefee sits 27% below chain after a 50% spike — transactions stall
divergences.fix: vm.fee(N) fuzzing at 0.2× and 5× of calibration value; verify agent adjusts or halts gracefully

divergences.label: Uniswap v3 TWAP
divergences.forkBehavior: Price accumulator frozen at fork block; observe() draws from a static ring buffer that never grows
divergences.mainnetReality: Accumulator updated each block; TWAP drifts from spot after large swaps within the observation window
divergences.failureMode: Manipulation guard (spot vs. TWAP divergence) never fires in fork; agent ships without testing it
divergences.fix: After forking, advance with vm.roll() and mine no-op swaps to prime the accumulator; verify guard triggers on divergence

divergences.label: Chainlink oracle price
divergences.forkBehavior: ETH/USD frozen at fork snapshot ($1,719.63); updatedAt never advances; latestRoundData() returns same value forever
divergences.mainnetReality: Updates on ≥0.5% price deviation or 3,600 s heartbeat; can be silent for up to one hour between updates
divergences.failureMode: Staleness guard never trips; liquidation thresholds drift during oracle silence without agent awareness
divergences.fix: vm.mockCall() with stale updatedAt (at boundary, past boundary, and far past); test extreme prices the fork never reaches
